_comment: "Look at the defending hero's hand and CHOOSE a card. THEY put it on the bottom of THEIR deck then THEY draw a card." The choose-and-bottom was a SELECT_FROM_REF carrying an `effects` list it does not read, so its whole body was unreachable and the card only looked. Inside it, PUT_CARDS_BOTTOM named target_ref "SELECTED" -- neither a key it reads nor a ref anything sets. The DRAW had no player and so would have gone to the CASTER; the card says they draw, which is the compensation that makes the effect fair. SELECT_FROM_REF reads the ref LOOK_AT stores and puts the choice under "chosen", which the two effects after it read.
